Class CardFactory

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.CardFactory
public class CardFactory extends Object
Singleton class responsible for loading card definitions from a JSON file, organizing them by group, and instantiating card objects.

The factory supports creating decks based on BoardType, generating individual cards by ID, and supports multiple card types mapped to their corresponding classes.

Cards are defined in a JSON file structured as groups (e.g., "levelOne", "learningFlight"), each containing an array of card definitions.

Example JSON structure: { "levelOne": [ { "id": 1, "cardType": "planets", ... }, ... ], "learningFlight": [ ... ] }

    • generateDeck

      public List<Card> generateDeck(BoardType deckType)
      Generates a card deck for a specific board type.

      For BoardType.LEARNING and BoardType.LEVEL_ONE, returns 8 random cards. For BoardType.LEVEL_TWO, returns 8 random level two cards plus 4 additional level one cards.

      Parameters:
      deckType - The type of the board to determine which group of cards to use.
      Returns:
      A list of 8–12 instantiated Card objects depending on the board type.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If there aren't enough cards for the specified board type.

    • generateCard

      public Card generateCard(BoardType deckType, int cardId)
      Generates a specific card by its ID for a given board type. Mainly used for testing.
      Parameters:
      deckType - The board type group from which to search for the card.
      cardId - The ID of the card to be generated.
      Returns:
      The instantiated Card object.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the group doesn't exist or the card ID isn't found.
